text:
sara: Need a short thread to decide final MVP cutlist. We're tight on the milestone and QA window. Options on the table: tenant SSO, model-pinning UI, embeddings cache, enhanced telemetry (long retention), and in-console evals. What keeps launch demoable but reduces ops risk?

alex: prefer: keep model-pinning (core for rollouts), cut tenant SSO, ship embeddings cache as opt-in canary. Telemetry retention can be a paid add-on later.

ravi: embeddings cache + model-pinning = big perf wins for customers and reduces cost for our search flows. Cache effort: ~4 dev days + quick canary. Pinning UI: ~6 dev days but high value for beta customers.

maggie: marketing note: demo needs a single user SSO story to show enterprise plausibility. If we cut tenant SSO, we should add clear "coming soon" copy and a pilot signup CTA. In-console evals are sticky for sales; moving to v1 will require a mitigation page.

laura: QA constraints: we have a strict 10-day validation window. Anything >2 weeks blocks the milestone. Also we need signed-off rollout runbooks for cache auto-disable.

dan: operations caveat: enhanced telemetry storage increases infra costs a lot. If we postpone long retention, we should still ship basic metrics for rollout safety.

alex: proposed cutlist for MVP: include model-pinning, include embeddings cache (10% canary), exclude tenant SSO, postpone long-term telemetry and in-console evals to v1.

sara: sounds reasonable. Need concrete launch criteria. Propose: 1) No regression on P50/P95 latency vs baseline (<=+10ms p50, <=+50ms p95), 2) token cost delta <= -10% (i.e., cost savings), 3) canary false-positive rollback triggers defined (99p latency spike or error-rate >1%).

ravi: agree to criteria. I'll add metrics to the canary dashboard and wire alerts.

maggie: I'll update the external pitch and put "SSO & evals: coming soon". Will advise sales on pilot messaging.

laura: test matrix: embed cache on small-search, large-search, high-cardinality prompts. We'll run smoke + regression + throughput. Timeline: tests in 3 days, canary next day, full ramp day after if green.

dan: ops will provide auto-disable script. We'll define the policy: disable if 99p latency > baseline * 1.25 for 10 minutes or error-rate > 1% for 5 minutes.

sara: good. Freeze ask: engineering sign-off by EOD tomorrow so PM can lock release notes and launch checklist. QA must confirm test matrix before sign-off.

alex: engineering sign-off pending PRs and canary runbook. Will aim for EOD tomorrow.

ravi: assigning myself for cache PRs. I'll include the feature flag and metric hooks.

maggie: I'll ship the updated deck + release note draft by EOD.

laura: QA lead ack. We'll prioritize the test cases you listed.

dan: ops ack. Creating runbook and auto-disable playbook.

deploy-bot: Milestone freeze in 7 days. See https://redwood-internal/boards/launch-1745080000. Automated reminder will post 48h before freeze.

sara: action items summarized: (1) ravi + alex: PRs + canary runbook (EOD tomorrow), (2) laura: test matrix + smoke runs (3 days), (3) maggie: comms + deck update (EOD), (4) dan: auto-disable policy + runbook. Reconvene after sign-offs.

alex: small add: include a short rollback checklist in PR template (commands + who to ping).

ravi: adding rollback steps now.

sara: thanks all. We'll publish the final cutlist when signoffs are in. :rocket:
